therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: HER2 tyrosine kinase inhibition combined with microtubule stabilization
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation inhibition in HER2-positive breast cancer with CNS penetration
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients with intracranial metastases

subgroup_findings: 2/6 patients at dose level 1 achieved CNS clinical benefit (SD ≥ 6 months)
0/5 patients at dose level 2 achieved CNS clinical benefit
results.dose_information: Dose level 1: 20 mg/m² cabazitaxel + lapatinib; Dose level 2: 25 mg/m² cabazitaxel + lapatinib; MTD not reached due to toxicities

context.investigator_commentary: Due to DLTs and other observed toxicities, a decision was made to close the study early
